title: Use GPT-5 in Unity with Coplay
author: Josvdw
selftext:
In this video I use GPT-5 to create (and fail) UI in Unity based on a screenshot of an example UI design file. I'll share the results from Claude in a reply.

Try it out and let me know what you think!  
Discord: [https://discord.gg/y4p8KfzrN4](https://discord.gg/y4p8KfzrN4)  
Installation:  [https://docs.coplay.dev/getting-started/installation](https://docs.coplay.dev/getting-started/installation)

replies.author: MysteriousPepper8908
replies.body: Far from perfect but it's a start. Does it include the code to make it functional? Or in terms of entering in a number of stars and hitting submit, you'd obviously need some sort of back end handling of how you're submitting ratings.

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body:
I usually add the UI logic as the second step to ensure it does both steps thoroughly.  
Here's a video where I first generate the UI and then add logic to it.  
[https://youtu.be/uaTCHemCJ08](https://youtu.be/uaTCHemCJ08)

comments.author: AwkwardWillow5159
comments.body: Does it generate the assets too? Or you provide it?

replies.author: Josvdw
replies.body: It generates the assets (sprites) in this example, but you can also provide it to Coplay if you have them.
